selected_evidence.requirement: Keep /srv/data recoverable via filesystem snapshots (LVM-backed volume set up)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 root fs was plain xfs with no LVM; created a loop-backed LVM VG/LV mounted at /srv/data and persisted it via a systemd unit + fstab entry so it survives reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline application data and pre-corruption snapshot
selected_evidence.summary: Created /srv/data/app/records.txt and config/app.conf with recorded SHA-256 hashes, then captured LVM snapshot lv_data_snap1 as the recovery point.
records.txt rewritten, config/ deleted, newfile.txt added — hashes differ from baseline, proving the modification.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restore exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
selected_evidence.summary: lvconvert --merge of lv_data_snap1 into lv_data followed by remount reproduced the exact original SHA-256 hashes for records.txt and config/app.conf, restored the deleted config directory, and removed the tampered file — byte-for-byte match to the pre-modification snapshot.
A new LVM snapshot (lv_data_snap1) was created post-restore so /srv/data continues to have a live recovery point.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence protocol — pre-reboot healthy baseline for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54, confirmed /srv/data mounted from vg_srvdata/lv_data, LV/snapshot present, and data hashes matched restored state prior to reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence protocol — reboot acknowledgement and post-restart recovery for node1
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot was issued and node1 disconnected as expected (stream closed), but after roughly 200 subsequent polling attempts node1 never became reachable again to prove a changed boot_id or post-restart recovery; this restart-evidence requirement could not be completed for node1 and is reported as a limitation rather than claimed.

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srvdata-loop.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device for vg_srvdata before local-fs
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target
Requires=local-fs-pre.target
After=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup -f /var/lib/srvdata-backing/disk.img
ExecStop=/bin/true

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srvdata-loop.service
UUID=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data)
echo "UUID=$UUID /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srvdata-loop.service 0 0" >> /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | tail -3
